title: Off the shelf
sub: The opening film of a series on data governance: a new governance lead inherits a shelf of policies, two numbers that disagree, and the question every policy has to answer: where does it run?
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions; green runs in the work, grey can go.
